about: The simulator's deep link of scene 2f1ddf5f (locale en) for each drawing request. Two writers must agree: packages/scenes/src/link.ts flyDeepLink (the page, the plain share link) and apps/api/server.py fly_link (the /s/<id> share page). packages/scenes/test/link.test.ts and apps/api/tests/test_feedback.py both read this table.
